evidenceNormalization: Ephemeral test-directory names and synthetic key fragments are normalized in assertion excerpts; source substitutions and test arguments are exact.
guardRefinements: An initial hostile-config mutation passed with a version-only include; malformed included configuration now detects sanitizer bypass.

An initial preview-deletion mutation passed because assertions iterated only the implementation reset list; seeded tables now have independent postconditions and every reset table must have nonempty fixtures.
An initial logging mutation passed because JSON.stringify(Error) omits its message; captured console arguments now use node:util format, including Error messages/stacks.

Some initial trial probes used nonexistent normal API paths. Actual project/turn/update endpoints and a complete flat-router allowlist now reject accidental ordinary-route registration, including early registration; the trial-route mutation was rerun and detected.
